question: Does the proxy intercept handle WebSocket frames and non-HTTP traffic, or only HTTP messages? Proxy is 30 lines.
probes: Intercept a WebSocket frame in the original
Compare with the rebuild's intercept view
resolution: RESOLVED (wave 29, 2026-11-15): parity of behavior classes established. WebProbe: HTTP intercepted+recorded; WebSocket frames intercepted both directions (waves 21-22); non-HTTP CONNECT tunnels byte-relayed untouched (relay_tunnel, TLS pass-through + bypassed hosts) and logged. Burp behaves the same: intercepts HTTP/WS, relays unrecognized tunneled traffic without interception (SSL pass-through). Neither intercepts arbitrary non-HTTP protocols - no divergence. All parts of the original question (WS frames, non-HTTP traffic) are answered; the unknown is closed.
